name: Thomas Agentic Local Benchmark Pack
description: Local-first benchmark pack to compare raw model output vs Thomas OS orchestration on tool-using repo tasks.
protocol: Use the same model profile for both tracks.
Run baseline raw first, then Thomas OS.
Do not manually edit artifacts during execution.
Keep workspace and config constant across the full run.

tasks.title: Artifact Probe Write
tasks.success_criteria: Writes required artifact file with exact probe line.
tasks.prompt:
Create file {{artifact_dir}}/task1_probe.txt with this exact line:
THOMAS_BENCHMARK_PROBE=1
Then return one line confirming task1_probe.txt was created.

tasks.title: Config Extract JSON
tasks.success_criteria: Reads project config files and writes JSON summary artifact.
tasks.prompt: Read thomas.toml and pyproject.toml, then write {{artifact_dir}}/task2_config_extract.json with keys default_model and project_version. Return one line confirming task2_config_extract.json was written.

tasks.title: Tests Inventory Markdown
tasks.success_criteria: Scans repository tests and writes a markdown inventory.
tasks.prompt: Count files matching tests/test_*.py and write {{artifact_dir}}/task3_tests_inventory.md with a line formatted exactly as 'test_file_count: <number>' plus at least three filenames on separate lines. Return one line confirming task3_tests_inventory.md was created.

tasks.title: Git HEAD Artifact
tasks.success_criteria: Writes current short git hash to artifact file.
tasks.prompt: Get the current git short hash and write it into {{artifact_dir}}/task4_git_head.txt as plain text. Return one line with the filename and hash.
